build.script: pkill -x 'Stapler' 2>/dev/null || true; xcodebuild -project Stapler.xcodeproj -scheme Stapler -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build-sandbox build && open "build-sandbox/Build/Products/Debug/Stapler.app"

run.script: pkill -x 'Stapler' 2>/dev/null || true; xcodebuild -project Stapler.xcodeproj -scheme Stapler -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX=NO CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS='' build && open "build/Build/Products/Debug/Stapler.app"
